summary: ADR-3 implemented (R-38). A lens is a file: five shipped under lenses/ (correctness, security, design, accessibility, data-integrity) with frontmatter naming the strictness from which each change kind, path glob or project type selects it; a project's .aegis/lenses/<name>.md wins on a name clash. The compiler derives policy.lens_matrix, lens_paths and lens_profiles from the files — the shipped files reproduce the former LENS_MATRIX constant exactly, locked by a test. Two auditor profiles (lens-auditor read-only, lens-runner may execute) replace the three per-lens profiles. `aegis lens prompt <TASK> <lens> [--with-contract]` assembles the review contract, the lens focus, that lens's own prior findings, the packet and the diff for any engine. The second engine is an answer (q.core.second-engine → capabilities.external_reviewer) that may be empty; scripts/aegis/external-lens.sh runs any CLI and records with --lens/--reviewer/--digest; codex-lens.sh is a thin wrapper over it. The workflow dispatches each lens to its plan profile with the assembled prompt. Documents lose the vendor names. The package was prepared on 2026-09-17 against the pre-deletion code (commit 1277dbe); two anchors were redone and two old tests updated for the deleted profiles and script. Round 1 (all three pass, five advisories, all fixed): a lens already always-on is not listed under a kind, so the three derived tables equal the former constant byte for byte (locked against the constant recovered from de5d662); a lens file's name is checked where it is read, with the same rule as a review file; external-lens.sh shows the engine's stderr, fails loudly, and sends a prompt over 100 KB on stdin; next's dispatch note and README name the plan profile, not a deleted one; ADR-3 documents the frontmatter as implemented. Round 2 (correctness, security; design fresh by kind): pass, two advisories declined below. After the gate: `land` refused the five shipped lens files as documentation outside the profile; a lens is procedure like a skill, so the unrequested-docs scan exempts the files load_lenses finds (one lock, red on the pre-fix commit).

First items of the next task that touches the lens tooling.
